_comment: All values denominated in W (wage-turns). 1 W = one tradesperson's wage for one turn. These are starting defaults to playtest against (Dial 2 in the reference sheet). Re-tune freely; the engine never hardcodes a price.

civil._comment: Dial 5. Defendant wins on roll >= target. base 2+ = 83%. Each modifier shifts the target; slick lawyer +2 (→4+/50%), late_or_botched +1 (→3+/67%), own_lawyer −1 (cancels a slick lawyer). court_penalty +1 makes a dodged-debt defense weak. deposit/match: both sides stake this; winner takes the pot.

npc_demand._comment: Dial 6. Each turn an NPC payable is dodged, roll d6 vs target = 1 + dodge#: 1st 2+, 2nd 3+, 3rd 4+, 4th 5+. On the 5th dodge there is no pass (→court) except a natural 6 forgives. 1st-dodge natural 6 → settle at settle_fraction. Fail → court (civil resolver at penalized target).
